items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I would like to take time out here and go back a few years, when I was with Lionel Hampton... The musicians were such as Paul Howard, Lloyd Allen... on trombone Lloyd Allen

ctx.x: His recovery has been marvelous for which we are all so very grateful. We now begin with the year 1935 and his experiences as a member of the Lionel Hampton Orchestra in Los Angeles.
I would like to take time out here and go back a few years, when I was with Lionel Hampton.
We had a very strong band, all experienced musicians. All had their homes and families here in Los Angeles. The musicians were such as Paul Howard, Lloyd Allen,
